redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-geographic fixtures only.
Public official pages or documents used as pinned validation receipts; access does not imply bulk redistribution rights.
A dataset-specific Govern d'Andorra release whose conditions of use, attribution, schema, coverage, validity, and reuse terms are pinned.
Licensed postal, address, building, or other restricted data kept outside public artifacts unless contract review explicitly permits release.
Third-party or unclear-rights data may detect discrepancies but cannot become authoritative public geometry.

sources.provider: Sociedad Estatal Correos y Telégrafos, S.A.
sources.production_scope: Licensed Andorra rows from a pinned Correos product edition retaining operator and country scope, locality or parish fields, contract, capture time, rights, and digest. Polygon authority requires the product manifest and contract to expressly include Andorra.
Pinned UPU addressing guide used for syntax, placement, examples, operator context, and code-component semantics only.
Only service-specific, permitted public address fields from a pinned release or approved interface; interaction, retention, caching, and redistribution rights are reviewed separately.
Dataset-specific permitted building fields and geometry pinned by feature identifier when available, scale, planimetric accuracy, edition, coverage, CRS, conditions of use, and digest.
Layer-by-layer review only; each artifact pins producer, authority, access class, conditions of use, service endpoint, schema, coverage, boundary policy and vintage, update date, CRS, and digest.

artifact_partitions.rule: Correos or other current operator evidence retains operator and Andorra scope, product edition, full code, locality or parish, capture time, contract, rights, and digest; licensed rows never silently enter public artifacts.
Urban Guide or other competent address assertions retain source identity, hierarchy, status, coordinate provenance, service release, access terms, rights, and postal cross-check status.
Address and topographic building identities remain distinct until a common authoritative identifier or reviewed crosswalk proves the link.

A Correos polygon is official only with express Andorra product scope; otherwise rights-cleared address membership may generate a versioned, uncertainty-bearing derived surface that is never official geometry.
Every boundary retains producer, policy, coverage, and vintage; parish coding does not substitute a full-code perimeter, and no border feature is assigned AD identity from nearest postal evidence.
Addressees, residents, owners, tenants, occupants, phones, credentials, cadastral rights, tax records, and protected register attributes never enter public artifacts.
Non-geographic fixture metadata only; never promotion evidence.
